limits: No new library component is qualified for electromagnetic simulation in this release.
Material tables and constant n/k are design records; no dispersive fit, anisotropic or active solver model added.
Named library ports are geometric intent, not solved modes.
Passive cavity layouts do not simulate gain, carrier injection, threshold or lasing.
No general Boolean CAD, full 3D solid rotations, foundry PDK/DRC, GDS hierarchy or all-platform installer claimed.
